project: 楚氏春秋·开局围宫 (Chu Shi Chun Qiu - Prologue)

Subject_1.name: 刘禅 (Liu Shan)
Subject_1.identity: 蜀汉皇帝 / 男主前世
Subject_1.visual_prompt: A 28-year-old Chinese emperor with sharp, calm facial features, intense eyes showing hidden ambition, wearing a traditional dark imperial yellow silk robe embroidered with golden dragons. Medium close-up, dramatic cinematic lighting, candlelight and shadow, 35mm film still.
Subject_1.voice_timbre: Deep, calm, resonant, cold imperial voice, Mandarin

Subject_2.name: 诸葛亮 (Zhuge Liang)
Subject_2.identity: 蜀汉丞相 / 权臣谋士
Subject_2.visual_prompt: A 54-year-old thin Chinese scholar statesman, serene and dignified expression with subtle regret in his eyes, wearing a Taoist crane氅 (headdress and black robe), holding a white feather fan. Medium shot, moonlight shining from the palace doors, cinematic atmosphere.
Subject_2.voice_timbre: Elderly, wise, sorrowful, composed scholar voice, Mandarin

Subject_3.name: 冷艳世家女子 (Noble Lady)
Subject_3.visual_prompt: A 22-year-old cold and proud Chinese noblewoman, wearing dark purple martial silk attire, hair tied in high noble bun, sharp hostile gaze, drawing an ancient Han sword. Dynamic close-up, high tension.
Subject_3.voice_timbre: Sharp, arrogant, aggressive young female voice, Mandarin

shots.visual_description: Inside a lavish Han dynasty imperial study room, bronze incense burner emitting faint smoke. A panicked young palace eunuch in blood-stained robes stumbles and falls to his knees onto the red carpet, pointing trembling hands toward the heavy doors.
shots.camera_movement: Slight camera shake, slowly pushing toward the eunuch on the floor
shots.dialogue: <d>[Mandarin]皇上！外面禁军死伤殆尽……诸葛丞相的大军已布下天罗地网，将皇宫彻底围死了！</d>
shots.sound_fx: Distant sound of swords clashing, heavy thunder, frantic footsteps, door bursting open
shots.negative_prompt: text, watermark, subtitles, English letters, blurry, deformed limbs, modern clothes

shots.visual_description: Emperor Liu Shan sitting calmly behind a massive dark sandalwood desk. The candlelight flickers against his sharp, unyielding profile. He holds a calligraphy brush, writing effortlessly without looking up, showing zero panic.
shots.camera_movement: Slow zoom in on his eyes and the tip of the brush
shots.dialogue: <d>[Mandarin]走？丞相不动则已，一动必是天罗地网，朕又能走到何处？</d>
shots.sound_fx: Sound of calligraphy brush scratching on Xuan paper, howling rain outside
shots.negative_prompt: text, watermark, subtitles, English letters, blurry, deformed limbs

shots.visual_description: The heavy carved red palace doors creak open. Lightning flashes, illuminating corpses outside in the rain. Chancellor Zhuge Liang, holding a white feather fan, steps into the hall with effortless grace, flanked by armored guards and a cold noblewoman.
shots.camera_movement: Wide shot slowly reframing and pushing toward Zhuge Liang's serene face
shots.dialogue: <d>[Mandarin]当真是龙困浅滩啊……想不到阿斗哥儿，也有今日。</d>
shots.sound_fx: Deep palace door creaking, roaring thunder, heavy armored boots marching in unison
shots.negative_prompt: text, watermark, subtitles, English letters, blurry, modern weapons

shots.visual_description: Over the shoulder of Zhuge Liang looking at Liu Shan. Liu Shan slowly puts down his brush, raising his cold, mocking gaze directly into Zhuge Liang's eyes. The tension between emperor and chancellor is palpable.
shots.camera_movement: Subtle handheld tracking shot, keeping both characters in focal tension
shots.dialogue: <d>[Mandarin]智者近乎妖。丞相大人，论阴谋诡计，朕终究比不上你啊。</d>
shots.sound_fx: Flickering candles crackling, breathless silence, distant thunder
shots.negative_prompt: text, watermark, subtitles, English letters, distorted faces

shots.scene: Sword Drawn & Final Resignation (剑拔弩张)
shots.visual_description: The cold noblewoman furiously draws her Han sword, blade gleaming cold silver in the lightning. Zhuge Liang gently raises his feather fan to halt her, closing his eyes with profound sorrow and regret.
shots.camera_movement: Rapid zoom on the drawn blade then panning to Zhuge Liang's closing eyes
shots.sound_fx: Metallic sword unsheathing sound, sharp wind blowing inside, dramatic epic string crescendo
shots.negative_prompt: text, watermark, subtitles, English letters, extra fingers, cartoon
